title: Accounting Changes and Error Corrections
summary: Governs accounting for and reporting changes in accounting principle, changes in accounting estimate, changes in reporting entity, and corrections of errors in previously issued financial statements.
description: ASC 250 governs accounting for and reporting (a) a change in accounting principle, (b) a change in accounting estimate, (c) a change in the reporting entity, and (d) the correction of an error in previously issued financial statements.
